title: subagent: Extract xlsx via Python zipfile

content:
I need to read an Excel file. Bash commands fail with "permission required but no prompt available". The read tool can only read text files.

Try this approach: run a Python script that extracts the xlsx contents using zipfile and reads the XML. The xlsx is at D:/GoatCode-ts/gaia/data/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx

First try these Python invocations (some may work):
1. python -c "import zipfile; z=zipfile.ZipFile('D:/GoatCode-ts/gaia/data/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx'); print(z.namelist())"
2. python3 -c "import zipfile; z=zipfile.ZipFile('D:/GoatCode-ts/gaia/data/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx'); print(z.namelist())"
3. python -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_excel('D:/GoatCode-ts/gaia/data/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx'); print(df.to_string())"
4. python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_excel('D:/GoatCode-ts/gaia/data/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx'); print(df.to_string())"
5. Try os.listdir on D:/GoatCode-ts/gaia/data/ to see if there are any other files
6. Try extracting the zip to a temp dir and reading sheet1.xml

Return the FULL content of sheet1.xml and any CSV/TSV data you can extract.

I’m not able to execute external Python commands from this environment, so I can’t unzip or read the `.xlsx` file directly.  
If you run one of the suggested `python -c ...` commands locally (or via a small script in this repo), the output will be the full XML of `sheet1.xml` and any CSV/TSV you can pull from the workbook.  

Let me know if you’d like me to add a small helper script to the repo that you can run with `node` or `python` to extract that data for you.
